description: Loyalsoldier GeoIP: IP-to-country databases in MaxMind (.mmdb) and V2Ray/Xray (.dat) formats, built weekly from MaxMind GeoLite2 with China's ranges from china-operator-ip and extra entries for Cloudflare, CloudFront, Fastly, Google, Facebook, Netflix, Telegram, Twitter and Tor.
notes: Data only, no program. The 'Loyalsoldier GeoIP' shortcut in Scoop Apps lists the files and their folder.
Upstream releases every Thursday; 'scoop update Loyalsoldier-GeoIP' fetches the new databases.
gesu/RealiTLScanner uses Country.mmdb from here by itself.
Xray reads geoip.dat from its own folder or from XRAY_LOCATION_ASSET; that folder also needs geosite.dat.
This product includes GeoLite2 data created by MaxMind, available from https://www.maxmind.com.

script: # Data only: the 'Loyalsoldier GeoIP' shortcut opens this micro-launcher, which lists the files.
$lines = @(
'@ECHO OFF',
':: Loyalsoldier GeoIP: shows what the package holds and where, then waits for a key.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
'ECHO Loyalsoldier GeoIP: IP-to-country databases from github.com/Loyalsoldier/geoip,',
'ECHO built from MaxMind GeoLite2 every Thursday; Scoop updates them with the package.',
'ECHO.',
('ECHO Release: ' + $version + ' (tag on GitHub, UTC date and time)'),
'ECHO Folder:  %~dp0',
'ECHO.',
'ECHO MaxMind format (.mmdb), for RealiTLScanner and other GeoIP2 readers:',
'ECHO   Country.mmdb                  countries; CDN ranges as CLOUDFLARE, GOOGLE, TELEGRAM...',
'ECHO   Country-without-asn.mmdb      plain country codes only',
'ECHO   Country-only-cn-private.mmdb  only CN and PRIVATE',
'ECHO   Country-asn.mmdb              only the CDN and service ranges',
'ECHO V2Ray / Xray format (.dat), for geoip: rules:',
'ECHO   geoip.dat                     every country plus the CDN and service lists',
'ECHO   geoip-only-cn-private.dat, geoip-asn.dat, cn.dat, private.dat  subsets',
'ECHO.',
'ECHO gesu/RealiTLScanner finds Country.mmdb here by itself.',
'ECHO Xray reads geoip.dat from its own folder or from XRAY_LOCATION_ASSET; that folder',
'ECHO also needs geosite.dat, which is not part of this package.',
'ECHO.',
'PAUSE',
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("$dir\Loyalsoldier-GeoIP.cmd", ($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
